skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts and theories related to operations and operations management.
Understand concepts and theories related to strategy and operations activities.
Apply various methods to solve practical operations problems.
Combine experience, knowledge, and tools to solve operations management issues.
Analyze project scenarios and practical operations examples.
Understand and apply lean manufacturing principles and JIT (Just-In-Time) concepts.
Understand the role and main activities of maintenance in operations.
Understand supply chain concepts and manage resources effectively.
Apply production planning techniques and manage production schedules.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and presentations.
